lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct vertical white lines. Spacing is approximately uniform across the mid-section, narrowing significantly toward the posterior flank.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: Bifurcation observed on the 9th line (anterior to posterior) forming an inverted Y-shape in the upper-mid torso; a secondary split is visible on the 10th line near the lower torso boundary.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Line 1 is abbreviated, terminating mid-torso. Lines 4 and 5 terminate prior to the ventral line. Several posterior line segments show clear discontinuities near the lower haunch.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: High-density cluster of approximately 7-8 circular spots concentrated on the lower lateral haunch and upper hind limb region.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three distinct spots align in a diagonal geometric vector from the mid-thigh toward the hock.

other_distinctive_markers: Two high-contrast white spots present on the malar region (cheek) below the eye; one prominent white marking on the upper inner forelimb.
